links.outcome: Gap between multiple-choice benchmark accuracy and human-rated answer quality
links.effect: Flan-PaLM reached 67.6% on MedQA, surpassing the prior state of the art by more than 17%, yet human evaluation revealed key gaps. Med-PaLM remained inferior to clinicians.
links.quote: However, human evaluation reveals key gaps.

unlisted_practices: Instruction prompt tuning to align LLMs to the medical domain using a few exemplars
Multi-axis human evaluation framework (factuality, comprehension, reasoning, harm, bias)

screen.reason: The paper introduces the MultiMedQA benchmark, evaluates LLMs (PaLM, Flan-PaLM, Med-PaLM) across multiple medical question answering datasets, and develops instruction prompt tuning, but does not test organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
